doctor.bio_short: Dr. Basma Fallah is a board-certified orthodontist and second-generation specialist who has practiced for 22 years — 16 in her own North Richland Hills office. An ABO Diplomate who has taught Invisalign technique as adjunct faculty at the University of the Pacific, she runs an aligner-first practice built for complex cases other providers say require braces. Every patient receives CBCT-based airway evaluation as part of a standard intake, connecting orthodontic treatment to airway, sleep, and developmental health.
